appraisal_events.evidence: elle me laissa prendre avec tant de facilité maintenant ce qu'elle avait refusé jadis avec une mine si sévère ... j'appris à ces détestables signes, qu'enfin j'étais en train d'embrasser la joue d'Albertine.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator finally attains the long-desired kiss, which Albertine now grants easily in sharp contrast to her stern refusal at Balbec; the passage treats this realized intimacy as its dominant attained outcome despite the hesitant, philosophically undercut mode of arriving at it.

appraisal_events.evidence: une bien plus étonnante se produisit en Albertine ... un air ... de bonne volonté docile, de simplicité presque puérile ... une sorte de dévouement conventionnel et subit ... elle trouvait que les baisers impliquent l'amour et que l'amour l'emporte sur tout autre devoir.
appraisal_events.explanation: Beyond granting the kiss, Albertine responds to the ensuing intimacy with an unexpected, narrator-admired docility and devotion, treating the moment as bound up with love rather than mere physical accommodation; the text explicitly marks this as the more astonishing development.

status_effects.explanation: The dominant local movement is realized, mutual intimacy: Albertine easily grants what she once sternly refused, marking a clear gain in mutual receptivity within the relation.

Albertine is admiringly portrayed by the narrator as unexpectedly devoted, gentle, and almost innocently generous in the moments following their intimacy, a narrator-endorsed elevation of her character in this scene.
